Ingredients: 200 g all-purpose flour, 300 ml milk, 1 egg, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 30 g butter, 0.25 tsp salt
Cooking instructions: 1. Mix the dry ingredients. 2. Whisk the milk and egg separately. 3. Combine the wet and dry mixtures. 4. Cook small portions on a lightly buttered pan until golden on both sides.

Ingredients: 4 eggs, 0.5 bell pepper, 0.25 onion, 1 small tomato, 30 g spinach, 0.25 tsp salt, 0.25 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp olive oil
Cooking instructions: 1. Beat the eggs. 2. Saute the chopped vegetables briefly. 3. Pour in the eggs and cook until set. 4. Fold the omelette and serve warm.

Ingredients: 4 slices bread, 1 large avocado, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 0.25 tsp salt, 0.25 tsp black pepper, 6 cherry tomatoes
Cooking instructions: 1. Toast the bread. 2. Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper. 3. Spread the avocado mixture over the toast. 4. Top with sliced cherry tomatoes.

Ingredients: 4 slices bread, 2 eggs, 120 ml milk, 0.5 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 15 g butter, 2 tbsp maple syrup
Cooking instructions: 1. Whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla. 2. Dip the bread into the mixture. 3. Cook the bread in butter until golden on both sides. 4. Serve with maple syrup.

Ingredients: 300 g Greek yogurt, 80 g granola, 100 g strawberries, 80 g blueberries, 2 tbsp honey
Cooking instructions: 1. Add a layer of Greek yogurt to a glass. 2. Add layers of granola and berries. 3. Repeat the layers as desired. 4. Drizzle honey on top and serve immediately.

Ingredients: 2 large tortillas, 4 eggs, 80 g cheddar cheese, 100 g black beans, 1 medium tomato, 1 avocado, 4 tbsp salsa
Cooking instructions: 1. Scramble the eggs. 2. Warm the tortilla. 3. Add the eggs, cheese, beans, tomato, avocado, and salsa. 4. Roll the tortilla tightly and serve.

Ingredients: 100 g rolled oats, 400 ml milk, 1 large banana, 0.5 tsp cinnamon, 1 tbsp honey, 30 g walnuts
Cooking instructions: 1. Cook the oats with milk until creamy. 2. Stir in the sliced banana and cinnamon. 3. Top with honey and walnuts. 4. Serve warm.

Ingredients: 4 eggs, 400 g canned tomatoes, 1 medium onion, 1 bell pepper, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tbsp olive oil
Cooking instructions: 1. Saute the onion, pepper, and garlic. 2. Add the tomatoes and spices. 3. Simmer the sauce for a few minutes. 4. Make small wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs. 5. Cover and cook until the eggs are set.

Ingredients: 4 eggs, 60 g feta cheese, 1 tbsp chopped parsley, 1 tbsp chopped chives, 15 g butter, 0.25 tsp salt, 0.25 tsp black pepper
Cooking instructions: 1. Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper. 2. Cook gently in butter while stirring often. 3. Fold in the feta and herbs. 4. Serve warm.

Ingredients: 100 g rolled oats, 400 ml milk, 1 medium apple, 0.5 tsp cinnamon, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 30 g raisins
Cooking instructions: 1. Cook the oats in milk. 2. Add the diced apple, cinnamon, sugar, and raisins. 3. Simmer until the apple softens. 4. Serve warm.

Ingredients: 1 bread roll, 1 egg, 30 g cheddar cheese, 2 lettuce leaves, 2 tomato slices, 1 tbsp mayonnaise
Cooking instructions: 1. Cook the egg to your preference. 2. Toast the roll. 3. Add the cheese, egg, lettuce, tomato, and mayonnaise. 4. Close the sandwich and serve.

Ingredients: 2 bananas, 200 g mixed berries, 150 g yogurt, 100 ml milk, 60 g granola, 1 tbsp chia seeds
Cooking instructions: 1. Blend the banana, berries, yogurt, and a small amount of milk until thick. 2. Pour the mixture into a bowl. 3. Top with granola and chia seeds. 4. Serve immediately.

Ingredients: 2 large tortillas, 250 g cooked chicken, 100 g romaine lettuce, 40 g Parmesan cheese, 4 tbsp Caesar dressing, 30 g croutons
Cooking instructions: 1. Slice the cooked chicken. 2. Mix the chicken with lettuce, Parmesan, dressing, and crushed croutons. 3. Spoon the mixture onto a tortilla. 4. Wrap tightly and serve.

Ingredients: 300 g pasta, 2 cans tuna (about 240 g drained), 1 cucumber, 200 g cherry tomatoes, 150 g corn, 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp lemon juice
Cooking instructions: 1. Cook the pasta and allow it to cool. 2. Mix the pasta with tuna, chopped vegetables, corn, mayonnaise, and lemon juice. 3. Chill the salad. 4. Serve cold.

Ingredients: 4 slices bread, 120 g cheddar cheese, 30 g butter
Cooking instructions: 1. Butter the outside of the bread slices. 2. Place the cheese between the slices. 3. Cook in a pan until the first side is golden. 4. Flip and cook until the second side is golden and the cheese has melted.

Ingredients: 500 g chicken breast, 300 g uncooked rice, 1 cucumber, 2 tomatoes, 100 g lettuce, 150 g yogurt sauce, 2 tbsp shawarma spices
Cooking instructions: 1. Season and cook the chicken. 2. Slice the cooked chicken. 3. Place rice in a serving bowl. 4. Top with the chicken, chopped vegetables, and yogurt sauce.

Ingredients: 250 g red lentils, 1 medium onion, 2 carrots, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1.2 L vegetable stock, 2 tbsp lemon juice
Cooking instructions: 1. Saute the onion, carrot, and garlic. 2. Add the lentils, cumin, and stock. 3. Simmer until the lentils are tender. 4. Blend the soup if desired. 5. Finish with lemon juice and serve.

Ingredients: 6 slices bread, 200 g turkey slices, 80 g lettuce, 1 tomato, 80 g cheese, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 0.5 cucumber
Cooking instructions: 1. Toast the bread. 2. Layer the turkey, lettuce, tomato, cheese, cucumber, and mayonnaise. 3. Close the sandwich. 4. Cut and serve.

Ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas (about 480 g drained), 1 cucumber, 2 tomatoes, 0.5 red onion, 30 g parsley, 100 g feta cheese, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp lemon juice
Cooking instructions: 1. Combine the chickpeas and chopped vegetables. 2. Add the feta, olive oil, and lemon juice. 3. Toss well to combine. 4. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Ingredients: 2 large tortillas, 250 g ground beef, 120 g cheddar cheese, 0.5 onion, 0.5 bell pepper, 4 tbsp salsa
Cooking instructions: 1. Cook the beef with onion and pepper. 2. Spread the beef mixture and cheese over a tortilla. 3. Fold the tortilla in half. 4. Toast in a pan until crisp and the cheese has melted.

Ingredients: 350 g pasta, 400 g chicken breast, 120 g pesto sauce, 200 g cherry tomatoes, 60 g Parmesan cheese
Cooking instructions: 1. Cook the pasta according to the package instructions. 2. Cook the chicken separately and slice it. 3. Toss the pasta, chicken, pesto, and tomatoes together. 4. Finish with Parmesan and serve.

Ingredients: 4 pita breads, 12 falafel pieces, 100 g lettuce, 2 tomatoes, 1 cucumber, 120 g tahini sauce
Cooking instructions: 1. Warm the pita and falafel. 2. Fill the pita with the vegetables and falafel. 3. Drizzle with tahini sauce. 4. Serve warm.

Ingredients: 400 g chicken breast, 200 g noodles, 2 carrots, 2 celery stalks, 1 onion, 1.2 L chicken stock, 20 g parsley
Cooking instructions: 1. Simmer the chicken with vegetables and stock until the chicken is cooked. 2. Remove and shred the chicken. 3. Return the chicken to the pot and add the noodles. 4. Cook until the noodles are tender. 5. Finish with parsley and serve.

Ingredients: 2 ciabatta rolls, 200 g mozzarella, 2 tomatoes, 20 g fresh basil, 2 tbsp pesto, 1 tbsp balsamic glaze
Cooking instructions: 1. Slice the bread. 2. Layer the mozzarella, tomato, basil, and pesto. 3. Drizzle with balsamic glaze. 4. Close the sandwich and serve.

Ingredients: 350 g spaghetti, 500 g ground beef, 1 medium onion, 2 garlic cloves, 500 g tomato sauce, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tbsp olive oil, 60 g Parmesan cheese
Cooking instructions: 1. Saute the onion and garlic. 2. Add the beef and cook until browned. 3. Add the tomato sauce and oregano. 4. Simmer the sauce. 5. Serve over cooked spaghetti and top with Parmesan.

Ingredients: 600 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp lemon juice, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp oregano, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.25 tsp black pepper
Cooking instructions: 1. Marinate the chicken with lemon, garlic, oil, and seasonings. 2. Heat a grill or pan. 3. Cook the chicken until fully cooked and lightly browned. 4. Rest briefly before serving.

Ingredients: 500 g beef strips, 250 g broccoli, 1 bell pepper, 2 carrots, 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 1 tbsp sesame oil
Cooking instructions: 1. Stir-fry the beef over high heat. 2. Remove the beef from the pan briefly. 3. Cook the vegetables. 4. Return the beef to the pan. 5. Add the soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil and toss well.

Ingredients: 600 g chicken, 1 medium onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 tbsp curry powder, 400 ml coconut milk, 2 tomatoes, 300 g uncooked rice
Cooking instructions: 1. Saute the onion, garlic, and ginger. 2. Add the chicken and curry powder. 3. Add the tomato and coconut milk. 4. Simmer until the chicken is fully cooked. 5. Serve with rice.

Ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (about 150 g each), 1 zucchini, 1 bell pepper, 250 g broccoli, 1 lemon, 2 tbsp olive oil, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.25 tsp black pepper
Cooking instructions: 1. Place the salmon and vegetables on a baking tray. 2. Season with oil, lemon, salt, and pepper. 3. Bake until the salmon flakes easily and the vegetables are tender. 4. Serve warm.

Ingredients: 600 g ground beef, 4 burger buns, 100 g lettuce, 1 tomato, 0.5 onion, 4 slices cheddar cheese, 4 tbsp ketchup, 2 tbsp mustard
Cooking instructions: 1. Shape the beef into patties. 2. Season the patties. 3. Cook the patties until done. 4. Toast the buns. 5. Assemble with cheese, vegetables, ketchup, and mustard.

Ingredients: 600 g cooked rice, 2 carrots, 150 g peas, 150 g corn, 3 eggs, 4 tbsp soy sauce, 3 green onions, 1 tbsp sesame oil
Cooking instructions: 1. Scramble the eggs. 2. Add the vegetables and cook briefly. 3. Stir in the rice. 4. Season with soy sauce and sesame oil. 5. Finish with green onion and serve.

Ingredients: 600 g chicken breast, 2 bell peppers, 1 large onion, 8 small tortillas, 2 tbsp fajita seasoning, 1 lime, 120 g sour cream
Cooking instructions: 1. Cook the seasoned chicken strips with peppers and onion. 2. Squeeze lime juice over the mixture. 3. Warm the tortillas. 4. Serve the chicken mixture in the tortillas with sour cream.

Ingredients: 350 g pasta, 300 g mushrooms, 3 garlic cloves, 250 ml cooking cream, 70 g Parmesan cheese, 30 g butter, 20 g parsley
Cooking instructions: 1. Cook the pasta. 2. Saute the mushrooms and garlic in butter. 3. Add the cream and Parmesan. 4. Toss the sauce with the cooked pasta. 5. Garnish with parsley and serve.

Ingredients: 500 g ground beef, 8 taco shells, 100 g lettuce, 2 tomatoes, 120 g cheddar cheese, 2 tbsp taco seasoning, 120 g salsa
Cooking instructions: 1. Brown the beef with taco seasoning. 2. Warm the taco shells if desired. 3. Fill each shell with beef. 4. Top with lettuce, tomato, cheese, and salsa.

Ingredients: 300 g couscous, 1 zucchini, 1 eggplant, 1 bell pepper, 1 can chickpeas (about 240 g drained), 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 lemon, 20 g parsley
Cooking instructions: 1. Roast the chopped vegetables until tender. 2. Prepare the couscous. 3. Combine the couscous with the roasted vegetables and chickpeas. 4. Add lemon and parsley, then mix and serve.

Ingredients: 800 g chicken thighs, 800 g potatoes, 1 large onion, 4 garlic cloves, 2 tsp paprika, 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tsp rosemary
Cooking instructions: 1. Arrange the chicken, potatoes, and onion on a tray. 2. Season with garlic, paprika, oil, and rosemary. 3. Bake until the chicken is fully cooked and the potatoes are golden. 4. Serve warm.

Ingredients: 250 g all-purpose flour, 170 g butter, 150 g brown sugar, 80 g white sugar, 1 egg, 200 g chocolate chips, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp vanilla extract
Cooking instructions: 1. Cream the butter and sugars. 2. Mix in the egg and vanilla. 3. Add the flour and baking soda and mix to form a dough. 4. Fold in the chocolate chips. 5. Shape the dough into portions. 6. Bake until lightly golden.

Ingredients: 200 g dark chocolate, 150 g butter, 200 g sugar, 3 eggs, 100 g flour, 30 g cocoa powder, 1 tsp vanilla extract
Cooking instructions: 1. Melt the chocolate and butter. 2. Whisk in the sugar and eggs. 3. Fold in the flour and cocoa. 4. Pour the batter into a pan. 5. Bake until the center is just set. 6. Cool before slicing.

Ingredients: 200 g flour, 180 g sugar, 120 g butter, 2 eggs, 120 ml milk, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 tsp vanilla extract
Cooking instructions: 1. Cream the butter and sugar. 2. Beat in the eggs and vanilla. 3. Alternate adding the flour mixture and milk. 4. Divide the batter into cupcake liners. 5. Bake until risen and cooked through. 6. Cool before serving or decorating.

Ingredients: 300 g cream cheese, 120 g digestive biscuits, 50 g butter, 80 g sugar, 200 g strawberries, 150 ml whipping cream
Cooking instructions: 1. Mix the crushed biscuits with melted butter. 2. Press the biscuit mixture into the cups. 3. Beat the cream cheese with sugar and cream. 4. Layer the cream cheese mixture over the biscuit base. 5. Top with strawberries and chill before serving.

Ingredients: 3 ripe bananas, 250 g flour, 150 g sugar, 100 g butter, 2 eggs, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp cinnamon
Cooking instructions: 1. Mash the bananas. 2. Mix with melted butter, sugar, and eggs. 3. Fold in the flour, baking soda, and cinnamon. 4. Pour the batter into a loaf pan. 5. Bake until cooked through. 6. Cool before slicing.

Ingredients: 6 medium apples, 150 g flour, 100 g rolled oats, 120 g brown sugar, 120 g butter, 1 tsp cinnamon
Cooking instructions: 1. Place the sliced apples in a baking dish. 2. Rub the flour, oats, sugar, butter, and cinnamon together to make the crumble. 3. Scatter the crumble mixture over the apples. 4. Bake until golden and the apples are tender. 5. Serve warm.

Ingredients: 200 g dark chocolate, 300 ml whipping cream, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract
Cooking instructions: 1. Melt the chocolate and allow it to cool slightly. 2. Whip the cream with sugar and vanilla. 3. Gently fold the melted chocolate into the whipped cream. 4. Divide into serving cups. 5. Chill until set.

Ingredients: 150 g rice, 1 L milk, 100 g sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 0.5 tsp cinnamon
Cooking instructions: 1. Combine the rice, milk, and sugar in a pot. 2. Simmer over low heat until thick and creamy. 3. Stir in the vanilla. 4. Serve with cinnamon.

Ingredients: 200 g flour, 170 g butter, 250 g sugar, 4 eggs, 120 ml lemon juice, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 30 g powdered sugar
Cooking instructions: 1. Prepare and bake the butter-flour crust. 2. Whisk together the lemon and egg filling. 3. Pour the filling over the baked crust. 4. Bake again until the filling is set. 5. Cool completely. 6. Dust with powdered sugar and slice.

Ingredients: 500 g flour, 250 ml milk, 7 g dry yeast, 60 g sugar, 100 g butter, 2 tbsp cinnamon, 120 g brown sugar, 100 g powdered sugar
Cooking instructions: 1. Prepare the dough and let it rise. 2. Roll out the dough. 3. Spread with butter and cinnamon sugar. 4. Roll the dough into a log and slice it. 5. Let the rolls rise again. 6. Bake until golden. 7. Glaze before serving.

Ingredients: 250 g strawberries, 250 g grapes, 3 kiwi fruits, 1 large mango, 150 g blueberries, 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp lime juice
Cooking instructions: 1. Chop the fruit into bite-sized pieces. 2. Mix the honey with lime juice. 3. Pour the dressing over the fruit. 4. Toss gently to coat. 5. Chill before serving.

Ingredients: 200 g ladyfinger biscuits, 300 g mascarpone cheese, 250 ml strong coffee, 2 tbsp cocoa powder, 80 g sugar, 200 ml whipping cream
Cooking instructions: 1. Dip the ladyfingers briefly in coffee. 2. Place a layer of ladyfingers in each cup. 3. Add a layer of sweetened mascarpone cream. 4. Repeat the layers. 5. Dust with cocoa. 6. Chill before serving.

Ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter, 2 cloves garlic, chopped, ½ medium onion, chopped, 5 ounces spinach, n/a, 1 teaspoon pepper (for spinach), ⅓ cup breadcrumbs, 4 ounces cream cheese, ¼ cup Parmesan, shredded, 2 tablespoons dill, chopped, 1 sheet puff pastry, softened to room temperature, 1 salmon filet, 1 teaspoon salt (for salmon), 1 teaspoon pepper (for salmon), 1 egg, beaten
Cooking instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). 2. In a pan over medium heat, melt butter. Add the garlic and onions, cooking until translucent, about 5 minutes. 3. Add the spinach, salt, and pepper, cooking until spinach is wilted, about 1 minute. 4. Add the breadcrumbs, cream cheese, parmesan, and dill, stirring until mixture is evenly combined. Remove from heat and set aside. 5. On a cutting board, smooth out the sheet of puff pastry. Place the salmon in the middle of the pastry and season both sides with salt and pepper. 6. Place several spoonfuls of the spinach mixture on top of the salmon, smoothing it out so that it does not spill over the sides. 7. Fold the edges of the puff pastry over the salmon and spinach, starting with the longer sides and then the shorter ends. Trim any excess pastry from the ends, then fold the ends on top. Flip the puff pastry-wrapped salmon over and transfer for a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. 8. Brush the beaten egg on the top and sides of the pastry. Score the top of the pastry with a knife, cutting shallow diagonal lines to create a crosshatch pattern. 9. Brush the top again with the egg wash. 10. Bake for 20-25 minutes, until pastry is golden brown. 11. Slice, then serve! 12. Enjoy!
